Enrollment Condition
data.description: Definition of an enrolled participant
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee must review available safety data before up-titration to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concerns Precluding Dose Increase
data.description: Participant remains at 15 mg/day if up-titration poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: CRU Discharge Condition at Day 9
data.description: Discharge from CRU on Day 9 is conditional; participants may remain inpatient
data.text: Participants will be admitted to the CRU for Treatment Period 1 on Day -8 and may be discharged on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study. At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Extension of the Outpatient Period requires Investigator approval and additional investigational product
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period. In such cases, the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Adaptive features implemented at Investigator discretion without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Criterion (Bilirubin)
data.description: Bilirubin elevation with concurrent ALT elevation indicative of liver injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption, weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Dose Modification Criterion
data.description: Decline in neutrophils from baseline when baseline neutrophils below reference range
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Criterion
data.description: Neurologic worsening triggers dose modification evaluation
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data. Rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Criterion
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening triggers dose modification evaluation
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Limit
data.description: Maximum number of rechallenges and dose level for rechallenge
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. For rechallenges, participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge. Rechallenge after bilirubin elevation requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor and may occur at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding After Enrollment
data.description: Investigator determination of continued participation after clinically significant finding
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed. This review of the ECG printed at the time of collection must be documented. Any new clinically relevant finding should be reported as an AE.

data.name: Women of Childbearing Potential Enrollment Condition
data.description: Negative serum pregnancy test required before enrollment
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Drug/Alcohol Screening Condition at Day -8
data.description: Positive drug toxicology or alcohol breath test precludes continuation to treatment
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids will not be tested); positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day -8.

data.name: Dietary Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to complete all meals on controlled diet
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are not eligible; while in the CRU participants will be strongly encouraged to complete all meals.

data.name: Outpatient Dosing Compliance Confirmation
data.description: SMS text messaging used to confirm dosing during Outpatient Period
data.text: During the Outpatient Period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.

data.name: Screening to Run-in Period Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day -7 (registered and assigned a participant number) and initiated on a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet; participants are admitted to the CRU on Day -8.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (diet equilibration Day -7 through Day -5 and pretreatment copper/molybdenum balance Day -4 through Day -1), participants will be administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1 for approximately 28 days.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the clinical research unit (CRU) on Day 9 to return on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose), unless they remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain study integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who were discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 for Treatment Period 2 and will remain in house until Day 40; all procedures will start on Day 23. If the Outpatient Period is extended (up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval), the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Titration to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days followed by titration up to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, after SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant and unless safety concerns preclude up-titration.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatic Abnormality
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, requiring approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurological or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For evidence of neurologic worsening or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening, the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Rechallenge After Dose Interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed; participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes that it is in best interest of the participant.

data.name: Mandatory Consideration for Study Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur during the study: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it is necessary for the participant.

data.name: Safety Follow-up After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up, with data collected per the SoA at the time of discontinuation and follow-up.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal From Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. The participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Transition
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before being deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter). Should the participant continue to be unreachable, he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Transition to Post-Study Therapy
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods of the study (ie, Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, consider and request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access. All participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days).

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (EOS Visit on Day 54 +/- 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (End of Study/Early Termination Visit) should be conducted as shown in the SoA, including a full physical examination; data to be collected at the time of study discontinuation and follow-up per the SoA.

data.name: Withdrawal by Participant or Investigator
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons; the reason must be recorded in source documents and CRF.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted after documented attempts (3 telephone calls and a certified letter); considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Withdrawal of Consent for Future Information Disclosure
data.description: If the participant withdraws consent for disclosure of future information, Alexion may retain and continue to use any data collected before such a withdrawal of consent; participant may request destruction of untested samples.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor or Investigator
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol/IRB/IEC/local health authority requirements, Alexion's procedures, or GCP guidelines; inadequate recruitment of participants; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. The Investigator may initiate study-site closure with reasonable cause and sufficient advance notice. If the study is prematurely terminated or suspended, the Investigator shall promptly inform the participant and should assure appropriate participant therapy and/or follow-up.

data.name: SRC Pre-Titration Safety Review Decision
data.description: The Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant to decide whether the participant may be titrated from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day on Day 29.

data.name: Day 9 CRU Discharge Decision
data.description: Decision whether to discharge the participant to the Outpatient Period on Day 9 or keep them in the CRU for safety or study integrity; also whether to extend the Outpatient Period up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision Based on Safety Laboratory Results
data.description: Decision at scheduled (Days -8, -1, 8, 23, 28) and weekly repeat/unscheduled safety laboratory assessments to reduce, interrupt, restrict increase, or rechallenge ALXN1840 dosing.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Assessment Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification based on copper control parameters and clinical data; decision re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Eligibility Confirmation at Enrollment/Check-in
data.description: Confirmation of eligibility, negative urine drug toxicology and alcohol breath test on Day -8, and negative serum pregnancy test prior to registration on Day -7.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Decision at Day 40
data.description: At the end of both inpatient periods (Day 40), decision whether the participant resumes prior therapy, transitions to other standard of care, or requests continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access.
